errors.evidence: The chart is a nested donut chart with two rings. The large dark red area is a segment of the inner ring, not a ring itself.
The large blue area is a segment of the outer ring, not a ring itself. This misrepresents the fundamental structure of the chart.
The segment for Mistral (1.2%) is white or a very light color, not dark red. The large segment in the same ring, belonging to GPT-4o, is dark red.
